name: German Empire
facts: Germany, with parts now in Poland and other neighbours

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of black, white and red.
flag.symbolism: Black and white were the colours of Prussia, and red and white those of the Hanseatic trading cities.

hook: The Kaiser's Germany was black, white, red from the top; turn it upside down and you get Yemen, and today's Germany swapped to black, red, gold.
trivia: The tricolour was first adopted by the North German Confederation in 1867 and kept when the empire was founded in 1871.
The Nazi regime brought back the black-white-red tricolour in 1933, flying it alongside the swastika flag until 1935.
